items.evidence: AC#1 acceptance test passes; it asserts calls === playerActions, before-state chaining, ok results with clean checkState, zero counts for sizes 3..10 and 10,000-hand default run. Holdout: 40 clean runs (seeds 1,2,3,1234,99999 x sizes 3..10, 4000 hands each, 2,763,909 actions) → 0 violations; 1600 completed hands at sizes 3..10 → checkState [] on every final state.

Unit test passes and uses exact toEqual on one-violation arrays per sub-check plus clean twins (fold-out and showdown included). Holdout on an independent 4-seat turn state: C1 (fractional, NaN), C2, C3 (pot->stack), B1 via turn history and betCount 7, B1 boundary at exactly 4, P1 duplicate and side-pot malformed, P2, P4, K1 (-1, 1.5), K2 extra burn, K3 board/burn duplicate, L1 out-of-turn, L3 wrong call amount, L5 wrong added on a raise and missing history entry → each exactly one violation with the §5 template text; clean states return the shared frozen empty array; 10 mangled deep-frozen states never throw nor mutate; one step breaking all five returns them in INVARIANTS order.

AC#2 passes (exit 1, only the faulted id >= 1, total = Invariant violations, control exits 0 with no block). Holdout: five independent fault engines through main (--hands 30 --seed 5 --size 5): folded seat kept eligible → pot-eligibility only; flop missing a board card → cards only; call recorded as check → legal-action only; betCount forced to 5 → bet-cap only; $2 shifted between stacks → chips only ('seat 1 has $162 but should have $160'). All exit 1 with counts summing to the total.

AC#3 passes (labels order, exact tail = counts/First violation/Violation/Replay + formatHand, offending raise last; replay-mode variant has one hand block and no Replay line). Holdout: for each of my five fault engines, stdout ends exactly with the expected block built from runPlaytest's firstViolation; firstViolation equals the earliest violating hand found independently; pasting each Replay line's arguments into main with the real engine exits 0.

AC#5 passes (exit 1, Invariant violations: 1, counts end 'cards 0, test-probe 1', hand 2 action 3, 5-record history, Hands played: 4). Holdout: a hook returning the same custom id twice per action over 3 hands → count line ends 'cards 0, x 3', Invariant violations: 6 (entries), violationCounts per hand = 3.
